editorial.blurb: A warm neighborhood gem where hand-crafted everything—from tallow-cooked fries to homemade sauces and top-notch cocktails—meets genuinely welcoming service that makes you feel like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit happy hour for mixology-quality cocktails at a steal, and don't skip the brunch special eggs—reviewers rave that the simplest dishes taste unexpectedly incredible here.
